mapper.select: SELECT * FROM popup WHERE site_id = #{siteId} ORDER BY display_priority DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup (site_id, title, content_html, position, x_offset, y_offset, width, height, show_from, show_until, show_today_close, display_priority, target_type, target_role_codes, status) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{title}, #{contentHtml}, #{position}, #{xOffset}, #{yOffset}, #{width}, #{height}, #{showFrom}, #{showUntil}, #{showTodayClose}, #{displayPriority}, #{targetType}, CAST(#{targetRoleCodes, typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.auth.repository.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE popup SET title = #{title}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, position = #{position}, show_from = #{showFrom}, show_until = #{showUntil}, show_today_close = #{showTodayClose}, display_priority = #{displayPriority}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_role_codes = CAST(#{targetRoleCodes, typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.auth.repository.typehandler.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
